title: Accu-Chek Guide Meter
body:
Hi,
I connected my AC Guide meter via BT to my Samsung S5 mini using the latest nightly of the xdrip+ app. Unfortunately I am not able to switch the slider under "use Bluetooth Meter" to on. Is this a known issue or am I just too stupid?
Thanks

comments.body: For some meters, you have to take a BG sample before you can switch the slider on.  For instance, I use the Contour Next One, and that is what I had to do.
Thank you, will try. Unfortunately it did not help, the slider stays gray. And at one point in time the meter says, that transmitting data failed.
This meter has never been tested. I haven't been able to obtain one. I'm not sure if they are available in the UK.
Thank you for commenting. This explaines a lot. I assume that every meter has its own perks although there is the BT standard.
The Accu-Chek Guide is standard conform, so it works with xDrip. I tested it a moment ago.

Try the following instructions:

On the meter:
- "Settings"
- "Wireless"
- "Pairing"
- "Pair device"

On your phone:
- Open xDrip
- "Settings"
- "Glucose Meters"
- "Scan for Bluetooth Meter"
- Select your meter
- Enter the code your meter displays
- Go back
- Turn on "Use Bluetooth Meter"

You might need to remove the pairing in your phone's system menu and on the meter in the following way:
- "Settings"
- "Wireless"
- "Pairing"
- "Delete Pairing"
- Select your phone

xDrip might not work with the meter when "Accu-Chek Connect" is installed.
Danke, das sind ja gute Nachrichten.
@kallnap did you manage to get this to work?
I will mark this as resolved.
